summary: This bill amends federal law to make it a crime punishable by up to 10 years in prison to perform surgeries or administer puberty blockers and cross-sex hormones on minors to alter their genitals or bodies to match a sex different from their biological sex, or to conduct female genital mutilation, when linked to interstate commerce, with limited medical exceptions.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes new federal criminal offenses related to gender-affirming care for minors and broadens the scope of an existing federal criminal offense regarding female genital mutilation. It introduces stricter penalties and expands what constitutes a crime, aligning with a stricter approach to justice.
